description: Scaffold of the Xero app emulator: it launches as --port=N, answers GET /admin/health with {"status":"ok"}, and serves the shared admin plane (reset, state, config, quirks), issues tokens at POST /connect/token for the authorization_code, refresh_token and client_credentials grants, and lists tenant connections at GET /connections (bearer-authenticated). Under /api.xro/2.0 it serves GET Organisation and GET Accounts (a seeded demo chart of 8 accounts, per tenant) and PUT Contacts (creates contacts per tenant, accepting {Contacts:[...]} or a bare contact; the emulator assigns ContactID and defaults status to ACTIVE; it validates each contact: a name is required, fields keep to their lengths, names are unique among active contacts, account numbers are unique, and any invalid contact refuses the whole request with a 400 ValidationException that echoes every contact) and GET Contacts (lists a tenant's contacts, filtered by where, including a single = as well as ==, IDs, searchTerm and includeArchived, with summaryOnly and page-numbered pagination: the pagination object appears only when page is sent, and the summary form is returned without page; the order parameter and If-Modified-Since are not served yet) and PUT Invoices (creates invoices per tenant, accepting {Invoices:[...]} or a bare invoice and answering 200 with the plural envelope; computed and read-only fields are ignored, line amounts and totals are computed, AmountDue starts at Total, status defaults to DRAFT, and ACCREC invoices are numbered INV-0001 style; a new invoice is validated: Type, Status, Contact, InvoiceNumber length and per-Type uniqueness, AccountCode and line presence, and any invalid invoice refuses the whole request with a 400 ValidationException that echoes every invoice; summarizeErrors=false per-item answers are not served yet). Webhooks are registered through admin routes under /admin/webhooks, which stand in for Xero's developer portal: registration runs the intent-to-receive check, and enabled subscriptions receive signed deliveries. The remaining Xero Accounting routes arrive in later slices of build plan xero-bp1.
